provenance: Synthetic prompts, 2026-09-26: generated per group by an offload LLM that never saw the router, relabelled by an independent model (gemini); only items where both labels agree are kept. Hard negatives (tool-ish words, no tool needed) are marked. The eval fixtures (ChatEvalFixtures) are NOT in here: they are the router's test set. The 'activity' group was regenerated the same day (44 items, same two-model agreement) after the fixture test showed the first batch was mostly reminders, not look-backs at the user's history with the assistant: a class-level gap found by the test set, disclosed here.
